ul.li: task — global top category (anchor); 1 task : N crons, 1 task : N threads
cron — trigger; isolated fire → new thread, shared fire → continue one thread (a turn)
thread — one engine execution / conversation; engine_session_id is a field (the --resume handle), not an entity
cron_logs — per-fire scheduling ledger (local; records skips that produce no thread)
transport — inbox/outbox carry task_id/thread_id (delivery buffers, GC-able; not shown)
purple dashed — protocol frames; host owns the durable transcript (messages)

g.text: global top category — everything belongs here
